name: @rootform/distribution
description: Rootform public contracts and distribution metadata

scripts.check: bun scripts/validate-repository.ts && bun scripts/validate-oci-core-profile.ts && bun scripts/validate-trivy-policy.ts && bun run typecheck && bun run check:format && bun test scripts
scripts.check:format: biome check .github .trivyignore.yaml AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md TRADEMARKS.md package.json public-export.json contracts dependencies docs examples policy-packs scripts schemas
scripts.format: biome check --write .github .trivyignore.yaml AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md TRADEMARKS.md package.json public-export.json contracts dependencies docs examples policy-packs scripts schemas
